route: 6 (keying polarity) + 7 (marker item) + response-direction check against the study's own scoring script and scored frame
evidence: Route 6 (keying polarity) + route 7 (marker item) + a direction check, all computed as server-side Redivis aggregates on the live table (no export); re-runnable as verify_CV_OASIS_ODSIS_PPE_Novak_2020_RSES.R. (a) Live per-item correlation with RSES_1: RSES_2 -0.291, RSES_3 +0.323, RSES_4 +0.284, RSES_5 -0.180, RSES_6 -0.267, RSES_7 +0.260, RSES_8 -0.256, RSES_9 -0.294, RSES_10 +0.544. The negative set is exactly {2,5,6,8,9}, matching both the study's own .Rmd rescoring list (CZ_short_OASIS_ODSIS.Rmd lines 220-224) and the reverse-keyed positions of the circulated RSES ordering -- 1 of C(10,5)=252 possible 5-subsets. (b) Live raw per-item means 2.11 / 2.72 / 1.82 / 1.78 / 2.91 / 2.90 / 1.93 / 2.38 / 2.87 / 1.93 for RSES_1..10, n=2374 for every item; the raw OSF files (ex+pa after the IRW script's remove_na) reproduce all ten means to 2dp and n=2374 exactly, and the deposit's scored frame data.pa.aft.imp.Rds has pa means 2.9/2.8/3.2/3.2/3.0/3.0/3.1/2.4/3.0/3.1 against pa raw 2.1/2.8/1.8/1.8/3.0/3.0/1.9/2.5/1.9(->3.1) -- i.e. scored = 5-raw for {1,3,4,7,10} and = raw for {2,5,6,8,9}, so the live table stores RAW responses and the .Rmd's net flip lands on the positively worded set. (c) Direction: in the scored metric every item exceeds the 2.0 midpoint (min 2.38, max 3.22), as a community sample must; taken with (a) and (d) this fixes 1 = 'Strongly agree' ... 4 = 'Strongly disagree'. Note the direction test is NOT independent of the ordering -- the mirror hypothesis (raw 1 = strongly disagree with {2,5,6,8,9} positively worded) produces identical means and correlations, and is excluded only because no published RSES ordering is reverse-keyed at {1,3,4,7,10} while the circulated one is reverse-keyed at {2,5,6,8,9}. (d) Route 7: scored means 2.89 / 2.72 / 3.18 / 3.22 / 2.91 / 2.90 / 3.07 / 2.38 / 2.87 / 3.07 -- RSES_8 is the strict minimum at 2.38, 0.34 below the next lowest, matching 'I wish I could have more respect for myself', the least-endorsed RSES item in general samples; the top two are RSES_4 (3.22) and RSES_3 (3.18), the competence/good-qualities pair. RSES_1 and RSES_10 correlate 0.544 with each other against 0.26-0.32 with the other forward items, as expected for the two global self-evaluation items. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: it pins the reverse-keyed class {2,5,6,8,9}, the response direction, the position of RSES_8 and the {RSES_3, RSES_4} pair as a pair, but cannot separate RSES_3 from RSES_4, RSES_1 from RSES_10, or RSES_2 / RSES_5 / RSES_6 / RSES_9 from one another -- no per-item statistics for the Czech RSES are published in the deposit or the paper. Hence PARTIAL.
